asr.full_text: Welcome to another video! So if you have strong block notes, you probably already know that it's been a pretty crazy last 72 hours, and I know I had to quickly make this video because the dates and the recent announcements are quickly approaching. Now nothing I say in this video is financial advice, so please make sure to do your own research before putting your money into any projects. So I'll go ahead and talk about everything that you need to know before the upcoming stronger upgrade. so before we get started, make sure to smash the like button if you have strong notes, if you're interested in strong, or if you love passive income in general. and let's get into it. so on March 24th, strong blok posted on their twitter that they had an announcement about the new token stronger coming on Tuesday March 29th, and you can see that right here. So in the upcoming days, everyone in the strong block community was very eager for the announcement and the discord chat was on fire with everyone wanting to know when the announcement would happen. So finally, on March 29th sometime later in the day. The announcement was finally dropped and they did mention some really important dates and developments to be aware of if you're a part of the Strongblock community. So we're going to do a really quick overview of the dates and chat a little bit about each of them. So the first is March 29th. And that was this past Tuesday. So we saw the birth of the stronger token that's going to be used on strong chain. So that was a really big development in the project and they made a reply to this tweet with the token contract. So if we click on this it takes us to etherscan.io and we can see all the details about the token. So it has a 10 million max total supply and there is currently one holder. So if you like you can go ahead and copy this contract address and add it to your metamask just to make sure that you're dealing with the correct token. So as you can see, this token was born two days and three hours ago. So we have been awaiting the token Stronger as it was mentioned in the light paper and it's finally been born. So Stronger is an ERC-20 token, so it was minted on the ETH chain. Now when Strong chain launches, Stronger will convert to a native token with ERC-20 liquidity and Ethereum and other L1 and L2 bridges for seamless liquidity and interoperability. Well, strong chain will be a community owned chain and the majority of Stronger tokens have been set aside for the community, with no additional team and shareholder tokens. So the following is the initial proposed strong chain token structure, and a separate medium post describing the allocations will be published before the conversion. So that's gonna be on April 4th. But the birth of the stronger token is a really big development in the evolution of strong block. So a lot of people have been asking how the stronger token is going to affect the original tokens strong so if we go back to the strong block light paper we can get an idea of how stronger is going to affect the original token so under the topic the future of strong we see here that the introduction of stronger creates an opportunity for strong to be used for scarce rewards that will be harder to achieve so the introduction of stronger will really lower the cell pressure of strong and in turn cause the price to increase but we should be getting more info on this in the coming medium article and the ama so the second important date is the ama that's coming up on april 3rd which is just in a couple of days so that is going to be this sunday i'm recording this on march 31st so it's right around the corner so it's going to be in the morning of sunday at 8 a.m pacific standard time and i know i'm really excited for this because we haven't had an ama from strong since about a month ago so the last one was on february 19th of 2022. So it's been a while. So I know I'm very excited for this and I'm definitely going to clear up my Sunday just for this AMA. So make sure to be there because they're going to be answering some really important questions about the protocol. So it's going to be in voice format on their Discord. And if you haven't joined their Discord already, the link is right here on their Twitter profile. So make sure to be there at 8am Pacific Standard Time. So they're going to be answering some pretty important questions and you can go to their discord to have an idea on what questions are going to be answered. And they've open voting up to the public so you can vote on which questions you want them to answer as well. And you'll find this on their channel called vote on questions. So on april 4th we can look forward to them releasing a medium article with a lot more details about the token stronger but by then we should have an idea of what's going to happen from the ama but the medium article is going to go into more detail on what's gonna happen during the upgrade now on april 5th the upgrade will begin and it looks like there is going to be a snapshot of all the wallets that are associated with Nodes, Staking Strong, anyone holding strong in a wallet, and NFTs, as well. Now, no date has been announced for this snapshot, but just to be safe, it might be really smart to be ready for the snapshot by April 4th. Here's a tweet from Bacon Esk, and I think he's one of the mods for strong block and he said for all of those asking i imagine the snapshot will happen the day before the upgrade which is on april 4th so just to be smart i would say to get ready for the upgrade by april 4th so you might have already heard but some steps that you can take to get ready is to have a node hold strong a wallet, have strong in the pool or stake it or have an NFT. So having any of these will set you up to be ready for the upgrade. In addition to everything that's going to be shared in the medium article and at the AMA. So it looks like we are seeing the evolution of strong and things are looking really exciting. Something else that's really exciting that's coming up this Sunday is that StrongBlock is going to be celebrating there's 16 month anniversary of paying out rewards. And Saul from the StrongBlock marketing team mentioned that absolutely no other node projects have come near that so that's another really exciting thing that we can look forward to this coming Sunday. Something I think is pretty important that I forgot to mention is that there's going to be an aetherium service 1 node cap no details have been released about this but they should announce when the cap is going to be well ahead of time it might be smart to create as many aetherium nodes as you can before that happens and we should get some more information on this pretty soon so make sure to be on the lookout for that so a lot of exciting things have happened within the last few days like strong getting listed on poloniacs and of course the minting of our new token stronger now this is only just the beginning of more things that are going to be rolled out to the community and as i'm filming this looks like we just hit 445 000 nodes and we are just getting started so So if you enjoy this video and make sure to smash the like button go ahead and turn on the post notification so that whenever I release a video YouTube notifies you that I have. And make sure to smash the subscribe button as well if you enjoy this video. I have a twitter account right here that I post updates on, so you can check this out if you want to message me with questions or just want to chat about anything crypto related I will make sure to get back to you quickly because I'm always on here. okay so see you at the AMA on April 3rd at 8am pacific standard time. and if you enjoyed this video, you might enjoy the video that is on the screen right now. Thanks for watching!

some steps that you can take to get ready is to have a node hold strong a wallet, have strong in the pool or stake it or have an NFT. So having any of these will set you up to be ready for the upgrade.

textual.context: Presented as preparation advice by the speaker. The speaker also says the snapshot date had not been announced.
textual.potential_relevance: The stated upgrade-preparation condition is linked to holding or staking crypto assets or possessing an NFT, with an April 4 timing cue; later review could assess whether these actions affect upgrade eligibility or an expected outcome.
textual.limitations: These records do not establish that any action was required, what outcome would follow, whether the snapshot occurred, or whether viewers transferred or lost assets.

textual.observation: The speaker says an Ethereum service node cap is forthcoming and suggests creating as many Ethereum nodes as possible before the cap takes effect.

evidence.quote: there's going to be an aetherium service 1 node cap no details have been released about this but they should announce when the cap is going to be well ahead of time it might be smart to create as many aetherium nodes as you can before that happens

textual.context: Framed as the speaker's advice and explicitly qualified by the statement that no details about the cap had been released.
textual.potential_relevance: A recommendation to create multiple nodes is tied to an asserted upcoming cap and a before-the-deadline condition, which is an unusual action-and-urgency relationship for later context assessment.
textual.limitations: The records do not provide the cap's terms, deadline, cost, eligibility effect, or any resulting benefit, and do not establish that the cap was implemented.

visual.observation: Posts associated with StrongBlock promote the STRONG/STRNGR token and state that viewers should prepare for an upgrade to STRNGR by a specified date; another visible post claims the project has been paying rewards for 16 months.
visual.context: Promotional social-media posts about a crypto project and token; the visible material does not show a payment request or a completed upgrade.
visual.potential_relevance: A claimed reward history is presented alongside a requested token-upgrade preparation step and a date-specific condition, creating a reward-and-action relationship that may merit review.
visual.limitations: These frames do not establish whether rewards were actually paid, whether viewers were required to take a specific transaction step, or what occurred after the stated date.

textual_context_notes.observation: The speaker gives a financial-advice disclaimer and directs viewers to conduct their own research before investing.

evidence.quote: Now nothing I say in this video is financial advice, so please make sure to do your own research before putting your money into any projects.

visual_context_notes.observation: A profile visible in the material states that its content is opinion and includes the disclaimer 'NFA.'
A visible informational panel describes STRONGER as a utility token and lists token details including ERC-20 type, supply, and smart-contract information.

This asset-linked promotional guidance supports the scam interpretation, but the speaker's financial-advice disclaimer and the stated lack of finalized snapshot or cap details limit what can be concluded about required transactions, deception, losses, or later outcomes.
